facts.fact: 他19岁的纹身：无尽地图+无指向的空白罗盘
facts.anchor: An intricate compass rested on top of the map, but it was blank—no indication of north or south.

facts.fact: 纹身含义：自己开路，无视预设规则
facts.anchor: “I got it as a reminder that I forge my own path, regardless of predetermined ‘rules.’”

facts.fact: 她的蒲公英纹身：希望/蜕变/治愈，推得穿水泥
facts.anchor: Dandelions can push through concrete, survive harsh weather, and still turn into something beautiful.

facts.fact: 家族代价：离开=失去家人关系
facts.anchor: “No. It wasn’t.” I smoothed my hand over her skin, trying to calm myself. “It cost me my relationship with my family.”

facts.fact: 设边界像断肢，质疑一切像坠入深渊，但不后悔
facts.anchor: Setting boundaries with my family had felt like cutting off a limb.

facts.fact: 他试过联系Levi、赎罪——对牛弹琴
facts.anchor: trying to get through to him was like talking to a brick wall.

facts.fact: 内心警告：必须告诉她真相，one night可能毁掉一切
facts.anchor: You need to tell her the truth.

facts.fact: 赛后短信立新绰号：LC=Lucky Charm
赛后复盘已成瘾：不管谁打完都聊
facts.anchor: I’d come to crave our postgame debrief.

facts.fact: 长线策略宣言：她要一夜，他要开局
facts.anchor: To her, it was only supposed to be one night. For me, it was only the beginning.

facts.fact: 拒绝Boone的迷信请求：不分享Logan
facts.anchor: I didn’t want to share Logan—not with Boone or anyone else.

facts.fact: one-off双关：只此一次（他心里可不是）
私藏照片：她下巴以上的笑——被爱且知道被爱
facts.anchor: The one that said she was happy and safe, cared for and cherished. And she knew it.

facts.fact: Boone被中指照回绝后反而更迷她
facts.anchor: “I think I like her even more now.”
